main_synthetic.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed) synthetic oval inside the main turf course. Plays remarkably consistent regardless of rain, but features a pronounced tactical bias. Early speed ('E') and forward pressers ('P') holding the fence gain a massive efficiency advantage. Mid-race synthetic kickback makes it difficult for deep closers dropped too far back out of the slipstream.
main_synthetic.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: Stalls 1–4 offer a major advantage across all sprint distances up to 1280m due to tight turns and immediate positioning requirements. At the 1750m route start, inside stalls are critical to avoid getting caught wide.

handicapping_angles.acton_synthetic_specialists: Aggressively upgrade synthetic specialists with proven form at Acton, Geelong, or Ballarat Polytrack. Be skeptical of turf-only runners making their synthetic debut without prior synthetic trial performance.
handicapping_angles.regional_nsw_and_canberra_stables: Local Canberra yards (Keith Dryden, Norm Gardner, Matthew Dale, Joseph & Jones) and Goulburn/Kembla Grange trainers dominate winter Acton Polytrack cards.
